what: Two large-text menu items stuck at both top ends of the screen (far left · far right) are normally faded to 30%, and the current page’s item sits sharp at screen center. The moment another item is clicked, it slides to center over .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) (pulling half its own width takes .3s ease) and sharpens in .6s, while the item that was sitting there returns to its end slot and fades. It is a two-word header line where the menu is already in the next page’s place while the page changes by fade

options.wide: Only at this width (px) and above, faint and centered, default 768 — below that, the two items sit crisp at both ends
options.--fx-dim: Opacity of faint items (via style), default .3
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Length and curve of the move to center (via style), default .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.--fx-shift: Length of the half-width pull (via style), default .3s
options.--fx-fade: Fade in and out duration (via style), default .6s
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Menu items — first item at the left end, last item at the right end. The current page is aria-current="page"(item or inner a) or is-current

use:
• Projects
  • Studio
note: The panel (ul) has no height (items are absolute), so the caller sets the panel height to the text height. When there is no current item, as on the first page, both sit faintly at the two ends.
